t: 代尔阿克勒战役从萨法里德人手中拯救了巴格达.
te: The Battle of Dayr al-'Aqul saves Baghdad from the Saffarids.

t: 由小路易所率领的法兰克人势力阻止了西法兰克人的入侵并击败了皇帝查理二世("秃子").
te: Frankish forces led by Louis the Younger prevent a West Frankish invasion and defeat emperor Charles II ("the Bald").
